messages:
gwen: Quick follow-up from today's authz outage. Root cause summary: secret-rotation job raced with validator restart -> gateway used stale cached claims for ~90s; audit shipper hit a consumer rebalance and we lost ~25s of events. Need clear owners + short remediation window.
omar: Thanks. Can we get a minimal repro and a short list of immediate mitigations?
gwen: Minimal repro in incident doc: https://internal.redwood.com/ops/incident/2289990000. Steps: run rotation job -> validators restart -> gateway still serves cached claims until TTL or 401 triggers revalidate. If revalidate aligns with kafka rebalance, some events never make it to the sink. Immediate mitigations: 1) lower deploy concurrency for validators during rotations, 2) add revalidate-on-401 with a tight timeout, 3) quick audit-shipper retry buffer.
pat: I can own the revalidate-on-401 work. Plan: add a synchronous revalidation call on 401 with a 200ms timeout and a circuit to avoid amplification. Feature-flagged. ETA: Tue EOD.
omar: I'll own the rotation orchestration changes: make rotation commit atomic and gate validator restarts behind a checkpoint (so no node restarts mid-window). Also add a short deploy concurrency limit for rotation waves. ETA: Thu.
eng-oncall: I'll implement a temporary oncall runbook addition: if 401 spike seen, run `scripts/force-refresh-tokens --service gateway` and escalate to ops. Add a short snippet for curl repro.
sec-automation: Created ticket SEC-3244: "rotation-race-audit-gap" + linked SRV-4717. Watchers: gwen, omar, pat, eng-oncall. Status: open.
gwen: Ops ask: can infra add a short-lived local buffer for the audit shipper (30s) + idempotent sink retries? If infra can do that tomorrow we reduce risk while code changes land.
omar: I'll coordinate with infra; adding a throttle on rotation jobs is straightforward and should reduce consumer rebalance risk.
pat: PR opened: https://git.redwood.com/gateway/pulls/1892 - feature flag `auth.revalidate_401_v1`. Includes unit + integration tests. Requesting review from @omar and @eng-oncall.
eng-oncall: Runbook snippet added and a 4-week weekly consumer-lag monitoring reminder created. I'll paste the curl example in the ticket.
sec-automation: SEC-3244 updated: owners assigned, due date in 7 days, daily 10m standups optional.
gwen: Scheduling a 15m rollout/rollback handoff tomorrow 09:15 PST. Bring PR links, smoke tests, and kill-switch scripts. Treatment: 1-week remediation sprint; if any owner needs extension, update SEC-3244. :thumbsup:
pat: ack
omar: ack
eng-oncall: ack
sec-automation: SEC-3244 status changed to in_progress.
